decisions.reason: After only two years the handle family's value is still uncertain, and keeping it in a modular range costs little, so the option stays open.
The mitred lever family shares tooling and finishing with the core range, so holding it while demand becomes clearer costs little.
The multifunctional handle fits the firm's barrier-free and hygiene direction and shows no negative signal, so it is worth keeping to learn more.
Two years is too short for a durable architectural hardware line to reveal its value, and its low holding cost justifies waiting.
The design award and its dedicated page are positive results that support further commitment to the collection.
The bronze finish uses existing in-house finishing capability at minimal cost and adds variety across product families, so it is kept open.
